name: KUMONGA
about: New (PAD-658). Loop the Big loop to wake her there (6 loops, 12, then 18); four stages, each one's shots named on the line (tear the web on the shield platform while she webs it again, cut the strands on every spinner, the sting hurry-up, burn her with Godzilla and Minilla); cash the pot out at the right scoop. Son of Godzilla (1967).

intro.what: Kumonga stirs awake in its rocky pit, legs churning dust, then a low shot of it rising toward the sky, a run of two shots, 0:59:23.

loop.what: Kumonga lurks in the jungle bushes, eyes glowing, while Minilla wanders nearby, then creeps closer with Minilla beyond its legs, a calm run of four shots, 1:07:03.

web.what: Kumonga sprays a white jet of web from its mouth across the valley at Minilla, 1:09:26.

tear.what: Godzilla stands in the web field and burns the strands with his blue ray, 1:15:03.

strand.what: Minilla lies wrapped in Kumonga's web, struggling under the strands, 1:13:33.

sting.what: Kumonga's needle stabs out again and again at Godzilla, cut with Godzilla's face and eye, a run of shots, 1:18:42.

burn.what: Minilla's ray blasts Kumonga full in the face and the spider recoils, 1:17:49.

won.what: Kumonga lies dead on its back in the snow, legs curled up, 1:20:43.

lost.what: Godzilla, smothered in web, topples and thrashes on the ground, 1:16:26.

cashout.what: A calm view of the island from the sea after the fight, 1:19:06.

music.what: Akira Ifukube's heavy, pulsing main title march under the opening credits of Destroy All Monsters, 0:02:28.

chitter.what: Kumonga's shrill warbling whirr as its eyes light up in the dark pit, 0:59:30.

web.what: The hissing spray of Kumonga's web shooting out in the cave, 0:59:40.

tear.what: A crackling run of snaps as Godzilla's thrown rock smashes into Kumonga's lair, 1:14:42.

sting.what: Two sharp stabbing bursts as Kumonga's needle strikes Godzilla's eye, 1:18:48.

burn.what: The crackling zap of Godzilla's ray hitting Kumonga, 1:16:08.

won.what: A heavy crash as Kumonga is flipped onto its back, 1:18:53.

lost.what: Minilla's pained wavering cry while trapped in the web, 1:14:00.

cashout.what: Godzilla stands with his mouth open and gives a long, calm roar that fades away, 1:18:24.
